notes: Muddy brown paint over 8x16 cinderblock: the windowless one-storey box a Delco club is. The paint levels the block (unit variation 0.05 against cinderblock_delco's 0.16) and sinks into the joints, which stay dark enough to read as block from across the lot (the art standard measured the lighter joint as a value step off plaster_delco with nothing else changing); sun-faded chalky patches, run-down grime from the parapet, and a few irregular spots peeled back to the grey block. The painted grey patch and the white block letters on it are a sign, not a wall.
